title: Journey Through the Solar System - Gigmo Giggles Episode

scenes.action: Bobo the bear is looking through a toy telescope, while Luna the fox takes notes on a clipboard and Milo the robot rolls in with a spinning antenna.

motion.prompt: Smooth slow zoom-in toward Bobo and Luna as they examine the discovery screen.

visual.image_prompt: Stylized 2D cartoon animation frame: Bobo the honey-brown cartoon bear with sunny yellow neckerchief pointing excitedly at a glowing screen with Luna the orange fox in teal vest and Milo the sky-blue robot in a cozy sunlit treehouse. Bright vivid colors, clean outlines, storybook illustration.

audio.voice_direction: Bobo speaks with child-like excitement. Luna is cheerful and warm.

dialogue_lines.text: Hey Luna! Look at that! Why is journey through the solar system?
Great question, Bobo! Let's activate the Discovery Screen!

scenes.action: Milo the robot projects a glowing hologram showing the first step of the educational concept.

motion.prompt: Gentle pan left-to-right following Milo's holographic projection.

visual.image_prompt: Stylized 2D cartoon animation frame: Milo the sky-blue compact robot with lime-green glowing digital eyes projecting a sparkling educational holographic diagram. Bobo the friendly bear watches with wide sparkling eyes. Vibrant colors, clean lines.

audio.voice_direction: Milo has cute melodic robotic pitch. Bobo gasps with joy.

dialogue_lines.text: Beep-boop! Scanning parameters! The secret begins with sunlight and energy!
Whoa! It looks like magic, but it is actually science!

scenes.action: Luna shows a friendly diagram explaining how small particles join together into big wonders.

motion.prompt: Camera slow zoom-out revealing the full colorful diagram.

visual.image_prompt: Stylized 2D cartoon animation frame: Luna the orange cartoon fox explaining a colorful chart with Bobo the bear holding a giant magnifying glass. Bright sunny pastel colors, whimsical cartoon style.

audio.voice_direction: Luna speaks clearly with pedagogical rhythm. Milo chimes happily.

dialogue_lines.text: Exactly! When warm energy lifts tiny droplets into the sky, they bundle together into big fluffy clouds!
Affirmative! 100% calculation complete! Teamwork makes the dream work!

scenes.action: Bobo, Luna, and Milo smile directly at the screen, pointing at three glowing colorful letter buttons A, B, and C.

motion.prompt: Static shot with lively pulse bounce effect to spotlight the quiz choices.

visual.image_prompt: Stylized 2D cartoon animation frame: Bobo the bear, Luna the fox, and Milo the robot standing side by side waving at the camera in a vibrant TV game show studio with colorful question marks. High contrast, sunny yellow and cyan background.

audio.voice_direction: High energy call-and-response tone engaging young viewers.

dialogue_lines.text: Are you ready, Super Thinkers? Here comes our question of the day!
What is the key superpower behind today's discovery?
Think carefully and shout out your answer!
